verdict.rationale: Godot exposes a documented command-line interface, EditorScript/EditorInterface classes, and a headless mode that allow programmatic/scripted control, plus a built-in GDScript LSP for external tooling integration, which supports agentic/automated driving. However, there is no formal public REST/OpenAPI API, no llms.txt, and no official MCP server — community MCP integrations exist but are unofficial and fragmented. missing for 10: an official documented HTTP/REST or OpenAPI-style API, an official MCP server, and llms.txt or machine-readable API discovery endpoints.
